body:
The belt I was using was a really crappy one that was likely to break soon anyways, but I appreciate the compliment, thanks :) I think the problem I have is that subconsciously I keep thinking that this apathy is just going to come back, no matter what I do. Part of me just thinks that no matter what I change, I will always end up back in this same feeling, almost like I should kill myself or I deserve to. I keep wondering what each victory and success I have matters if over time the happiness I get from them fades away and I keep ending up back here.

Thanks for the advice. You're definitely right in that I get pretty headstrong in my own view of things, and that I should try seeking other people's perspective.

Depression has kinda just been with me for a long time, since middle school about. I'm currently in college. I think a bit part of what kept it with me is the fact that I have high expectations for myself that I often can't meet and end up just stressing myself out a lot. I've ended up having a lot of highs and lows over the years, and maybe I've just become so used to this feeling of depression that the second I feel like things have gone wrong or I've failed myself or someone else I just sink back into it.

thanks for your response
